text: This document is the title page front matter for an aerospace technical manual or specification conforming to the S1000D standard. This document is a highlights summary for a major release of the S1000D specification standard. It details the changes introduced in the latest issue, including eight change proposals and white papers that affected numerous chapters. The content covers deletions of obsolete sections, significant updates to business rule decision points (with new additions, deletions, and rewording), and widespread editorial changes across all chapters to comply with new authoring rules and templates. Tables provide chapter-by-chapter summaries of modifications affecting the front matter and primary content sections.
